name: Raxio MZ1
notes: Beluluane Industrial Park (MozParks), Matola-Boane, Maputo Province ~20 km from Maputo city; up to 400 racks, 2,000 sqm white space, 3 MW IT power per Raxio page; Uptime Tier III Certification of Design Documents and Constructed Facility; launched 2024-05-28; first Tier III Uptime-certified data centre in Mozambique; carrier-neutral.

name: iColo / Digital Realty Maputo One (MPM1)
notes: Maputo City centre; 80 racks, 350 sqm IT space, 9,500 sqm campus per iColo; opening announced 2023-02-07; carrier-neutral; Mozambique Internet Exchange (MozIX) entered MPM1 (iColo release 2025-05-13); Digital Realty lists MPM1 as its Maputo data center.

name: Vodacom Business Matola Data Center
notes: Tchumene, Matola, Maputo Province; inaugurated March 2025; USD 25m investment; foundation stone laid Oct 2023; carrier-neutral with direct 2Africa cable access hosted in Vodacom Matola equipment room; Uptime Institute lists Vodacom Business Matola Data Center with Tier III design and constructed-facility certification; capacity_mw kept null (not published by Vodacom).

name: UEM/CIUEM Hybrid Data Center
developer: Universidade Eduardo Mondlane / CIUEM (implemented by Triana Business)
notes: UEM main campus, Av. Julius Nyerere 3453, Maputo City; hybrid data center inaugurated 2026-08-03 (AIM/Tempo 07 Aug); supports UEM systems, research, AI/data science, .mz domain and MOZIX; institutional/university facility - not commercial colo unless service terms appear.

name: Maluana Science & Technology Park Data Centre (government)
developer: Government of Mozambique / Empresa Nacional de Parques de Ciencia e Tecnologia de Maluana
notes: Maluana village, Manhica district, Maputo Province (~53 km north of Maputo); science park contains a data centre; Aug 2025 Africa50 MoU includes modernization of the Maluana DC; June 2026 Council of Ministers extinguished the state science-park company (Decree 21/2012 revoked) - operational status of the DC itself pending official confirmation; government/institutional facility.

name: New National Data Centre (Africa50 MoU)
notes: MoU signed 2025-08-13 in Maputo by Minister Americo Muchanga (Comunicacoes e Transformacao Digital) and Africa50 chairman Alain Ebobisse; part of digital-transformation infrastructure programme alongside 3 power lines; site not yet named; aggregator-only source (orig. likely AIM/Radio Mocambique) - B/C pending official announcement.

name: Bubble Cloud (licensed cloud/data-residency service)
notes: First provider to receive INTIC cloud licensing under the 2026 cloud regime (Decreto 72/2025); AIM reports two data centers but no named physical sites verified; recorded as licensed cloud-service lead - NOT counted as physical DC until operator/INTIC names sites.

name: EDM National Control Centre data-centre components (Matalane/CTM)
notes: Utility/SCADA National Control Centre project with data-centre components at Matalane and CTM (Maputo) per EDM-branded RENMOZ 2026 presentation hosted by ALER; planned/under procurement; verify construction and commissioning in EDM tender/award documents.
